thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty page fired PD-INC-4921 // inference-eu-high-latency-prod - p95 latency > 1200ms, 5xx rate spike. Link: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/PD-INC-4921

alex: I'm on it, acking the incident. PD: ack PD-INC-4921 :white_check_mark:

alex: quick status - seeing consumer queue depth spike on `embed-processor` and a bunch of Redis timeouts (ERR - i/o timeout).

maya: on standby, pulling logs now. can you confirm which customer traffic is affected?

jamie: support reported errors for acme-corp and beta-saas around 16:12 UTC, ~30 failed requests in last 10m.

alex: running live checks: `kubectl get pods -n prod -l app=inference-worker -o wide` shows 4/12 pods crashlooping in eu-west-1.

alex: throwing a quick diagnostics dump:
```
# recent pod events
kubectl describe pod inference-worker-3 -n prod
# sample app logs tail
k logs inference-worker-3 -n prod --since=10m | grep ERROR | head -n 50
```

maya: logs show repeated `redis timeout` followed by retry flood. suspect a transient Redis failover or network partition to the Redis cluster. pinging infra.

ops-lead: joining bridge. tagging infra oncall @soro and db @lee (they're not in thread).

oncall-bot: Reminder: oncall rotation is maya for 16:00-00:00 UTC. Escalation policy will notify ops-lead if not acked in 5m.

maya: infra confirms increased latency from managed-redis EU region, partial outage during a control plane failover. SRE recommends throttling incoming requests and enabling fallback route.

jamie: can we flip the routing rule to `inference-fallback` for EU to route new requests to us-east until redis is healthy? impact: small config change. :thinking_face:

alex: I can add a temporary route. executing:  `redwood route update --service inference --region eu-west-1 --fallback us-east-1 --weight 0.1`

alex: applied fallback route, new traffic routing to us-east begins now. monitoring p95 across regions.

maya: deploying a hotfix to limit concurrent consumers to reduce retry storms. patching deployment:
```
kubectl patch deployment inference-worker -n prod -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"worker","env":[{"name":"MAX_CONCURRENCY","value":"8"}]}]}}}}'
```

alex: issued rolling restart on the problematic pods: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/inference-worker -n prod --timeout=5m`

jamie: support update: informing acme-corp and beta-saas of degraded performance, we saw ~7 failed requests per tenant, most retried successfully after ~90s.

ops-lead: good note — question for postmortem: why did retries amplify load and why wasn't KV caching preventing repeated hits?

alex: metrics update: eu p95 dropped from 1.3s -> 260ms after fallback + restart. 5xx rate trending back down.

maya: redis cluster reports recovered, no further timeouts in last 6m.

jamie: support confirms customer errors stopped. sending follow-up messages to affected customers with a short incident note.

sarah: quick impact summary for ticketing: partial latency spike in EU region for ~18 minutes, affecting inference calls that hit `embed-processor`. Estimated customer-visible errors: acme-corp (7 requests), beta-saas (4 requests). No data loss.

alex: marking incident as mitigated. PD note: `Mitigation: enabled fallback to us-east, limited concurrency, restarted unhealthy pods; redis cluster recovered.`

incident-bot: PD-INC-4921 acked by alex at 16:14 UTC. Status: Mitigated -> Monitoring.

oncall-bot: If no regression within 30m, incident will be auto-resolved.

alex: 10m check-in — p95 stable 220-300ms, 5xx ~0.05%. I'll keep monitoring for 30m then hand off to ops-lead for postmortem.

ops-lead: I'll take the postmortem writeup. alex/maya — please drop logs, timeline, and config diffs to the doc `#incidents/PD-INC-4921` when available.

sarah: adding customer impact bullet to the incident doc (support link: https://support.example/incidents/PD-INC-4921).

jamie: closing loop with customers in progress.

alex: resolving local runbooks and adding a short runbook action: add circuit-breaker on embed-processor to avoid retry amplification.

incident-bot: PD-INC-4921 status changed to RESOLVED by alex at 16:42 UTC. :white_check_mark:

alex: closing thread here. good triage. follow-up: postmortem doc assigned to ops-lead.
